comment: First tasks of the rented GPU machine (md/gpu/GPU_RUN.md, section 3). They need nothing that does not exist on 6 Oct 2026: the pre-flight tests use the built system restrained/X, the quantum chemistry the files of MCPB.py step 1. Read by md/gpu/queue.py; format in its header. Later tasks are added as further files (GPU_RUN.md, section 5). timeout_s of qm_opt and qm_hess (43200 s = 12 h for one attempt; three attempts at most) is a GUESS made on 6 Oct 2026 before either had run on this machine: replace it when the first optimisation steps and gradients have been timed (qm/prod/status.json).

tasks.title: (b) pre-flight interruption test of md/RUN.md: the same short run twice, the second one killed and resumed; result in status/preflight_interrupt.json
command: export WALL_A=$("$PY" -c "import sys, time; print(round(time.time() - float(sys.argv[1]), 1))" "$t0")
export KILL_AFTER=$("$PY" -c "import sys; print(max(3.0, round(float(sys.argv[1]) * float(sys.argv[2]), 1)))" "$WALL_A" "$PF_KILL_FRACTION")
echo "run A took $WALL_A s; run B gets SIGKILL after $KILL_AFTER s"
echo "exit code of the killed run: $CODE_B (137: killed by SIGKILL)"
[ "$CODE_B" = 137 ] || { echo "run B was not killed inside the run (exit code $CODE_B): the test says nothing; change PF_KILL_FRACTION"; exit 1; }
return dict(reversed(line.split()) for line in open(os.path.join(status, name)))
steps = ['min'] + [s['tag'] for s in ma['equilibration']['stages']] + [s['tag'] for s in ma['production']['segments']]
open_steps = [s for s in steps if f'rec_{s}.json' not in at_kill]
interrupted = open_steps[0] if open_steps else None
differing = sorted(f for f in set(a) | set(b) if a.get(f) != b.get(f))
sizes_equal = sorted(a) == sorted(b) and all(os.path.getsize(os.path.join(A, f)) == os.path.getsize(os.path.join(B, f)) for f in a if f.endswith('.dcd'))
out = {'result': 'IDENTICAL' if not differing else 'DIFFERENT', 'n_files_compared': len(a), 'differing_files': differing,
'files_of_that_step_at_the_kill': [f for f in at_kill if interrupted and f'_{interrupted}.' in f],
'status_a': ma['status'], 'status_b': mb['status'], 'invocations_b': [{'exit_code': i.get('exit_code'), 'outcome': i.get('outcome')} for i in inv],
'meaning': 'IDENTICAL: a segment repeated after an interruption is the segment that was lost. DIFFERENT: no frame is lost or doubled, '
'but a run cannot be regenerated bit for bit (md/RUN.md, section 2).'}
sound = ma['status'] == 'complete' and mb['status'] == 'complete' and sizes_equal and interrupted is not None and len(inv) == 2
print(out['result'], f"({len(a)} files; run B was killed during {interrupted} and resumed)" if sound else '- but the test is NOT sound, see ' + name)
